Dear Stakeholder,
The survey below has been prepared to assess your opinions and expectations regarding the services we provide as Gebze Technical University's Exchange Programs Office of the International Relations Coordination Office. Your evaluations will offer insights for us and guide our activities to serve you better. Therefore, careful completion of the survey is important. We thank you for your concern and contributions.
Please indicate your position within the institution:
☐ Incoming Student ☐ Incoming Staff
Please mark to what extent you agree with the statements below using the scale given below. 5- I strongly agree 4- I agree 3- I neither agree or disagree 2- I disagree 1- I strongly disagree N/A-Not Applicable
For us to be able to take your evaluation into consideration, please provide objective evidence in the opinions and suggestions section below for the statements you have rated as 1 or 2.
EVALUATION STATEMENTS | 5 | 4 | 3 | 2 | 1 | NA
1 | The information on the International Exchange Programs Office website is up-to-date and sufficient.
2 | I can easily reach the International Exchange Programs Office staff.
3 | I am satisfied with the International Exchange Programs Office's approach to questions and requests.
4 | The International Exchange Programs Office provides quick and accurate solutions to my service requests.
5 | I received the necessary support and service from the International Exchange Programs Office throughout my Erasmus+ mobility.
6 | I am generally satisfied with the activities of the International Exchange Programs Office.
7 | I am overall satisfied with the GTU homepage/website.
8 | I am overall satisfied with the availability of the course catalogue on the GTU website.
9 | I am overall satisfied with the content of the course catalogue on the GTU website.
10 | I am overall satisfied with the quality of the course catalogue on the GTU website.

12 | I am overall satisfied with the academic level of the courses on the GTU website.
13 | I am overall satisfied with the language of instruction of the courses on the GTU website.
14 | I am overall satisfied with the quality of education and teaching on the GTU website.
15 | I am overall satisfied with the accessibility of the faculty members on the GTU website.
16 | I am overall satisfied with the accessibility of the departmental Erasmus coordinator on the GTU website.
